messages:
Alex Martinez: hey all :wave: I just got my corporate Surface Pro X (SQ2). Went through OOBE/autopilot but Intune Company Portal immediately fails enrollment with error 0x80180014 and says 'device not supported'. BitLocker also won't enable. Anyone available for a one-time temp admin grant to run firmware updates and a workaround? /cc @Priya Kapoor

Priya Kapoor: welcome Alex — congrats! :tada: that error usually means Autopilot/Intune is choking on the ARM image or the Company Portal installer. Quick checks first: can you paste output of these from an admin CMD: `dsregcmd /status` and `wmic computersystem get model,manufacturer`? also confirm Windows build (Win+R -> winver)

Alex Martinez: sure, pasted below (copied from admin cmd):
```
DSREG STATUS
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Device State: Joined to Azure AD: YES
| Tenant: redwood-inference.onmicrosoft.com
| AdditionalStatus: 0x0
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
Manufacturer  Model
Microsoft     Surface Pro X
Windows 11 Pro 22H2 (Build 22621.1702)
```
Enrollment report: Intune shows 0x80180014 in the portal log. BitLocker settings greyed out in Settings -> Device encryption.

Priya Kapoor: ok — device is Azure AD joined but enrollment failed during autopilot provisioning. Surface Pro X is ARM; our current autopilot image sometimes fails if the Company Portal/Intune msi expects x86 support. Two options: (A) we push a firmware + autopilot profile tweak and enable the ARM-compatible installer, or (B) give you a temporary local admin (24h) so our engineer can remote in and install the compatibility package and finish BitLocker. Which do you prefer? We usually do (B) for faster developer setup.

Alex Martinez: (B) works for me. I need to get Dev tools installed today.

Joe Chen: I can issue a 24-hour temp admin. Alex, confirm you can do a screenshare in ~15m and keep the device plugged in + on wired or strong wifi. I'll create the account and drop creds in a direct message (we'll rotate after). :ok_hand:

Alex Martinez: ready in 10 — thanks! 

mdm-bot: [automated] autopilot-enroll FAILED for device Surface Pro X (serial: REDACTED) - code 0x80180014 - logged 2025-03-12T14:57:56Z

Priya Kapoor: steps we'll run while on screen (notes):
1) apply Surface firmware update via MSU from https://support.microsoft.com -> Surface drivers
2) install Company Portal x86/x64 compatibility shim (internal package)
3) re-run Company Portal and complete Intune enrollment -> confirm BitLocker policy applied
4) remove temp admin after verification

Joe Chen: temp admin created (24h) and DM sent to Alex. If anything blocks, escalate to eng-infra. Alex, reply here when you're back online after the session so we can close the thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
